title: hire_max_age is unconditionally satisfiable on Unix
description:
PlatformIdentity::observe() stamps SystemTime::now() inside every prove(), so claim.age_at(now) is ~0 and within_max_age (service.rs:297) always passes for the unix source. A consumer that sets hire_max_age=60 believing it bought a freshness control gets a token on every request, forever, from a source that observed nothing.

README:37 still reads 'Presence freshness (hire_max_age, 300s presence TTL) | enforced'. The new README paragraph and the SPEC note state only the assurance-field consequence, not this one.
